ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of Immigration Crackdown on Minnesota Businesses
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of the Trump administration's immigration crackdown on businesses in Minnesota, including the proposed $10M relief package.
questions: How will the relief package be distributed?
What are the long-term effects of the immigration crackdown on Minnesota businesses?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant issues with the relief package and the impact of the immigration crackdown on Minnesota businesses. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the problem.
